STORYBOARD REVIEW · 审稿

《我发现了豆芽》60 秒 · 10 秒 × 6 段

7 个关键帧，一格一张，全部以定妆照为参考生成；相邻两帧构成一段 10 秒视频。视频尚未生成，等你确认。

请重点看：① 人物是否始终是同一个人；② 6 段的时间戳节拍是否讲清了作文；③ 有没有哪一格需要重画。

0. 定妆照（所有人物格的参考）

做法：先出一张三视图定妆照，之后每一格都把它当作参考图传给模型（不是拿上一格当参考）， 所以第 1 格和第 7 格是同一个脸。

角色：10 岁中国女孩，圆脸、深棕色大眼睛、两条深色辫子绑红色发圈；米白色麻花针织衫、深蓝长裤、 棕色帆布鞋、橄榄绿帆布挎包。

画风：日式动画赛璐璐平涂，干净黑线，手绘水彩背景，暖奶油与蜂蜜色调。不要写实、不要 3D。

1. 六段分镜

01 00:00–00:10捧豆入厨房
旁白　十月一日，老师让我们观察豆芽。时长　10 秒运镜　慢推 / 慢移，全段无剪切
0–4s她站在灶台前，把纸袋凑到碗口，晨光从左边窗子斜进来
4–7s纸袋倾斜，绿豆成串落下，粒粒分明
7–10s豆子落满碗底，她的手停在半空，笑了笑
英文提示词（发给 MiniMax H3-Max 的原文）
Medium shot, side view: the girl stands at the worn wooden table in a sunlit village kitchen, holding a small paper bag of mung beans over a clear glass bowl. 0-4s: she leans in and tilts the bag toward the bowl, warm morning light from the left window, dust motes drifting. 4-7s: a steady stream of green beans pours from the bag, each bean sharp against the blurred background. 7-10s: the bag empties, beans settle in the bowl, she pauses with a small smile. Slow gentle push-in for the whole shot; no camera shake.
02 00:10–00:20豆子入水
旁白　我找妈妈要了一把绿豆，把它们泡在水里。时长　10 秒运镜　慢推 / 慢移，全段无剪切
0–3s清水注入碗中，豆子被冲得翻滚起来
3–7s水面慢慢静止，豆子沉底，细小的气泡往上冒
7–10s镜头贴近水面，一颗豆子轻轻浮起又落下
英文提示词（发给 MiniMax H3-Max 的原文）
Macro shot at bowl level: a clear glass bowl of green mung beans. 0-3s: clear water pours in from the left, the beans tumble and swirl. 3-7s: the water settles, beans sink to the bottom and pack together, tiny bubbles rise slowly, the surface ripples calm down. 7-10s: one bean drifts up toward the surface and settles back. Very slow lateral drift, shallow depth of field, warm window light on the glass rim.
03 00:20–00:30豆子长胖了
旁白　过了一天，绿豆长胖了，比原来大了一圈。时长　10 秒运镜　慢推 / 慢移，全段无剪切
0–4s碗里的豆子比昨天更圆更亮，水光在豆面上流动
4–7s镜头极缓推近，一颗豆子的表皮被撑得发亮
7–10s表皮沿着缝裂开，露出一点乳白的豆肉
英文提示词（发给 MiniMax H3-Max 的原文）
Macro shot, inside the glass bowl: swollen mung beans under clear water. 0-4s: the beans look rounder and glossier than before, warm light sliding across their wet skins. 4-7s: extremely slow push-in toward one bean, its skin stretched tight and shining. 7-10s: the skin splits along a seam and a sliver of pale ivory cotyledon shows through. Continuous slow push-in, gentle water refraction, no cuts.
04 00:30–00:40脱衣服、冒小芽
旁白　又过了一天，它们把衣服脱掉，露出嫩白嫩白的肚皮。时长　10 秒运镜　慢推 / 慢移，全段无剪切
0–4s豆皮被撑开，一片片翻卷下来
4–7s乳白的豆肉完全露出来，水光在上面滚
7–10s一根短短的白色小芽顶出来，弯着身子
英文提示词（发给 MiniMax H3-Max 的原文）
Macro shot, same bowl and light: bean skins splitting and peeling back. 0-4s: the pale skins curl away from the beans one by one, floating slightly. 4-7s: the ivory cotyledons are fully exposed, water highlights rolling over their surface. 7-10s: a short thick white shoot pushes out from a seam, curving upward, with a faint water sheen at its tip. Slow steady push-in; keep the same bowl, table and warm window light throughout.
05 00:40–00:50举碗对光
旁白　又过了好几天，绿豆长出了小芽。时长　10 秒运镜　慢推 / 慢移，全段无剪切
0–4s镜头从碗里的小芽抬起来，落到她脸上
4–7s她双手把碗举到窗前，逆光，芽尖透出金边
7–10s她微微侧头，眼睛发亮，笑出来
英文提示词（发给 MiniMax H3-Max 的原文）
From the bowl to the girl: begin inside the glass bowl with pale shoots, then tilt up and pull back. 0-4s: camera rises from the sprouts toward her face as she leans in. 4-7s: she lifts the bowl with both hands to the window, the morning sun backlights the shoots so their tips glow gold. 7-10s: she tilts her head slightly, eyes bright, and smiles; warm rim light on her braids and sweater. Smooth tilt-up and gentle pull-back, no cuts.
06 00:50–01:00端上桌
旁白　妈妈把豆芽炒好端上桌，我们开心地吃了起来。时长　10 秒运镜　慢推 / 慢移，全段无剪切
0–4s傍晚的厨房，妈妈端着冒热气的盘子走进画面
4–7s盘子落到木桌上，蒸汽升起，她坐直了身子
7–10s两人相视一笑，镜头极缓拉远收尾
英文提示词（发给 MiniMax H3-Max 的原文）
Wide-medium shot, late afternoon village kitchen. 0-4s: the mother in an indigo apron walks into frame carrying a steaming white plate of bean sprouts, warm evening light and long shadows. 4-7s: she sets the plate on the worn wooden table, steam curling up, the girl sits up straighter with her hands on the table. 7-10s: they look at each other and smile, the girl's eyes crinkling. Very slow pull-back to end the shot; keep both faces clearly visible, no cuts.
